cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(NicoOwnedExportOff LANGUAGES C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(CONFIG_SENTINEL 23)
configure_file(config.h.in generated/config.h @ONLY)
add_library(hidden STATIC hidden.c)
set_target_properties(hidden PROPERTIES EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS OFF)
target_compile_definitions(hidden PRIVATE TARGET_SENTINEL=17)
set_source_files_properties(hidden.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_DEFINITIONS SOURCE_SENTINEL=19 COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wextra")
target_include_directories(hidden PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
add_executable(visible main.c)
target_link_libraries(visible PRIVATE hidden)
